title: Private Tour of Niagara Falls with Niagara City Cruise
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Receive a 10% off souvenir shopping card at any Niagara Parks gift shop
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Private tour is priced per group from 1 to 10 people
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: On this 5 to 6-hour private tour, your fully qualified and experienced driver guide will take you Niagara Falls. Your trip includes complimentary hotel pickup and drop-off from Niagara Falls hotels and pickup locations, a licensed tour guide/driver, luxury vehicle, flexible pickup times, and a complimentary bottle of water. Get up close to the Falls and jump aboard the Niagara City boat cruise (not available in the winter months). Then travel to the the base and walk behind the Falls at Journey Behind the Falls,
